topic: The Debt Avalanche vs. Debt Snowball methods
hook: Two proven ways to pay down debt

plan_reasons.angle: no safe trend available right now (general trends, promotional already used enough today)

caption:
Choosing the right debt repayment strategy can make a big difference in how you manage your money. Whether you prefer the psychological boost of the Debt Snowball or the interest savings of the Debt Avalanche, both methods focus on consistency and organization. Look at your debts, note the balances and interest rates, and see which approach aligns with your personal goals. Which method do you find more motivating to stay consistent?
